newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested-USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area on Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. There were 1,100 head confirmed for the week to date, which includes 200 head or 4 loads of CME cattle delivered to packing plants.
The last established price was $69.00 per cwt on Friday.
Monday's packer bids were 68.00-69.00 with asking prices 70.00-71.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 500 Year Ago - 2,900
Wk to Date - 1,100 Week Ago - 1,100 Year Ago - 13,100
